India and Indonesia Sign Defense and Trade Deals, Including BrahMos Missile

India and Indonesia have finalized a defense deal worth $200 million for the BrahMos missile. The agreement also includes the purchase of Astra missiles and potential collaboration on the Sabang port. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Indonesia aimed to strengthen India's strategic position in the Indo-Pacific region, with discussions also covering electric vehicle (EV) technology and other trade agreements. The deals are seen as a move to boost India's defense exports and balance China's influence in the South China Sea.
